description: A modular, stack-agnostic toolkit for AI coding agents to autonomously find, reproduce, and patch vulnerabilities.

written.description: Reads a codebase and its commit history, builds a threat model from them, and sends agents to chase each hypothesis it raises. It then tries to reproduce each finding in a sandbox and attacks its own patch to check the fix holds, working from source alone with no running target.

alive.last_commit_message:
deps(reference): bump ADK, litellm, microsandbox

Bump reference dependencies to the latest Airlock-mirrored releases
compatible with hash-locked offline installation and CVE floors:

- `google-adk`: `2.11.0` -> `2.14.0` (`google-genai` `2.31.0` -> `2.34.0`)
- `litellm`: `1.101.3` -> `1.103.10` (replaces yanked `1.101.3` pin while
  staying below `1.104+`'s `filelock<4.0` constraint)
- `microsandbox`: `0.7.2` -> `0.7.13`
- `google-cloud-aiplatform`: `2.2.0` -> `2.8.0`
- Record explicit transitive security floors (`certifi>=2026.10.18`,
  `filelock>=4.2.1` -> `4.2.9`, `joserfc>=1.7.6` -> `1.8.0`) in
  `reference/requirements.in` and keep `tree-sitter-language-pack` pinned
  at `1.20.0` (the last release bundling offline grammars in the wheel).

Change-Id: I4cf01c14fd90139c3621220e04b166642aa49dbe
